messages:
anya: FYI I finished a regional quant sweep for raptor-13b across H100/A100 in us-east, us-west, eu-west. seeing consistent speedups on INT8 but eu-west INT8 quality looks off.
lee: what eval & metric?
anya: promptset_v2 (prod-like chat prompts) — metric is normalized answer-match % vs fp16 baseline.
anya: command I used:
```
./bench/quant_profile.sh --model raptor-13b --quant [fp16,int8,fp8] --gpus [h100,a100] --regions [us-east,us-west,eu-west] --batch 1 --seq 1024 --evalset promptset_v2
```
mike: got a summary? raw p50/qps/quality deltas?
perf-bot: aggregate summary (p50 latency / qps / quality delta vs fp16):
- h100 us-east: fp16 38ms / 190 qps / baseline
- h100 us-east: int8 28ms / 260 qps / -0.9 pts
- h100 eu-west: fp16 44ms / 165 qps / baseline
- h100 eu-west: int8 33ms / 220 qps / -3.1 pts  <- outlier
- a100 us-west: fp16 62ms / 110 qps / baseline
- a100 us-west: int8 48ms / 140 qps / -1.5 pts
anya: same qprofile JSON pushed to catalog (qprof: raptor13b-int8-v1). curious why eu-west degraded more.
lee: could be kernel variant differences or runtime flags. did kernel selection differ?
anya: runtime debug shows different matmul kernel chosen by region on H100:
```
[2026-03-12T14:12:05Z] kernel_select: model=raptor-13-b seq=1024 hardware=h100 region=eu-west selected=matmul_optimized_v2
[2026-03-12T14:12:05Z] kernel_select: model=raptor-13-b seq=1024 hardware=h100 region=us-east selected=matmul_optimized_v1
```
mike: that could change accumulation paths and numeric rounding. any micro-eval to confirm?
anya: ran decimal-debug micro-eval; v2 shows slightly different activation scaling/clipping (scale mismatch ~1e-3) for some tokens.
lee: can you force the v1 kernel in eu-west and rerun INT8?
anya: forced with env REDWOOD_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=matmul_optimized_v1, reran int8 in eu-west: quality delta vs fp16 now -1.0 pts (matches us-east behavior).
mike: confirms kernel variant is the main cause. good catch.
lee: next steps: short-term pin kernel or add a compatibility check during model onboarding. long-term: fix numeric path in v2.
anya: I'll open a PR to add a per-region kernel gating in the model catalog and add a regression test that asserts int8 delta <= 1.5 pts across regions for promptset_v2.
mike: also schedule a small canary in eu-west (10% traffic) to validate before full rollout.
deploy-bot: note: kernel override will require rolling restart of eu-west serving nodes.
anya: created eval artifact with triggers: s3://redwood-evals/raptor13b/qscan/1775554321/trigger_prompts.json
lee: add a short blurb in onboarding docs about kernel variants + quant sensitivity and include the new regression test.
anya: TL;DR: INT8 gives 20-40% speedups across GPUs; unexpected quality regression in eu-west traced to different matmul kernel variant (v2 numeric path). Workarounds: pin kernel to v1 or patch v2 to match numeric behaviour. I'll file tickets for kernel patch + add gating test.
mike: :thumbsup: tagging this for model-onboard checklist and kernel team follow-up.
__notes: No title field per agents.md. Thread contains root message + replies, chronological. All fields are strings or list of strings.
